        "contents": "# Shared AI Context for Mindmap\n\nThis directory contains the shared AI context implementation for the mindmap components, creating a unified context interface between the graph and menu components.\n\n## Overview\n\nThe &#96;SharedAIProvider&#96; centralizes all AI-related functionality in a single context provider. This approach:\n\n1. **Eliminates duplication** of context and function registrations\n2. **Ensures consistency** across components using the same AI assistant\n3. **Simplifies maintenance** by centralizing all AI-related code\n4. **Improves performance** by avoiding duplicate registrations with the Assistant UI runtime\n\n## Architecture\n\nThe shared context architecture follows these principles:\n\n1. **Single Source of Truth**: All AI-related state and functions live in one context\n2. **Unified Registration**: A single registration with the Assistant UI runtime\n3. **Shared Context Provider**: Components consume the same context\n4. **Standardized Interface**: Consistent function signatures across components\n\n## Implementation\n\n### The Provider\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n// SharedAIProvider sets up all AI functionality\n\u003cSharedAIProvider\u003e\n  {/* Components that need AI capabilities */}\n\u003c/SharedAIProvider\u003e\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### The Context Hook\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n// Inside any component that needs AI capabilities\nconst {\n  // State\n  activeCommand,\n  selectedModel,\n  \n  // Actions\n  setActiveCommand,\n  setSelectedModel,\n  \n  // Functions for graph interactions\n  handleAddNote,\n  handleFindConnections,\n  // ...more functions\n} = useSharedAI()\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Component Integration\n\nThe shared context integrates with components in two ways:\n\n### 1. Smart Components\n\nSmart components that wrap existing components:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n// SmartGraphWithSharedContext.tsx\nexport function SmartGraphWithSharedContext({ children }) {\n  // Access shared context\n  const { ... } = useSharedAI()\n  \n  // Render children (Graph component)\n  return \u003c\u003e{children}\u003c/\u003e\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. Direct Integration\n\nComponents can also use the context directly:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n",

        "contents": "# Composite Knowledge Layer Specification\n\n## Overview\n\nThis document outlines the design and implementation of a unified data layer that seamlessly integrates multiple knowledge sources:\n\n1. **Local Files** - PDFs/transcripts from &#96;/packages/knowledge-base&#96;\n2. **OpenAI Vector Storage** - Embedding database via OpenAI API\n3. **R2R Integration** - External RAG implementation (Read, Retrieve, Route)\n4. **Existing Databases** - Current Xata and Supabase data stores\n\nThe goal is to create a consistent interface for the AI pipelines to interact with all knowledge sources through a single API, with automatic source selection, blending, and transformation capabilities.\n\n## Architecture\n\n![Knowledge Layer Architecture Diagram]\n\nThe architecture follows a layered approach:\n\n1. **Data Source Adapters** - Interface with individual knowledge sources\n2. **Unified Knowledge API** - Common interface for all knowledge operations\n3. **Knowledge Context Provider** - React context for UI components\n4. **Cross-Source Utilities** - Functions that work across multiple sources\n\n## 1. Data Source Adapters\n\n### 1.1 Local Files Adapter\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;typescript\n// src/features/ai/knowledge/adapters/local-files-adapter.ts\n\nimport fs from 'fs';\nimport path from 'path';\nimport { createHash } from 'crypto';\nimport { KnowledgeItem, KnowledgeSource } from '../types';\n\n",

        "contents": "# Composite Knowledge Layer\n\nA unified knowledge management system that integrates multiple data sources and provides a consistent interface for AI pipelines.\n\n## Overview\n\nThe Composite Knowledge Layer provides a unified API for accessing and managing knowledge from various sources:\n\n- **Local Files**: Documents stored in the knowledge base directory\n- **OpenAI Vector Storage**: Embeddings and semantic search\n- **R2R**: External RAG implementation (Read, Retrieve, Route)\n- **Database (Xata)**: Structured data storage\n\n## Key Features\n\n- **Unified API**: Single interface for all knowledge operations\n- **Cross-Source Search**: Find information across all sources with deduplication\n- **AI Context Awareness**: Integration with Assistant UI for AI capabilities\n- **React Components**: Ready-to-use UI components for knowledge discovery\n- **Pipeline Integration**: Seamless integration with both unified and standalone pipelines\n\n## Usage\n\n### With Unified Pipeline\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nimport { IntegratedAIPipeline } from '@/features/ai/knowledge/integration'\n\nexport default function AIProcessingPage() {\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv className=\"container\"\u003e\n      \u003ch1\u003eAI Processing Hub\u003c/h1\u003e\n      \u003cIntegratedAIPipeline /\u003e\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  )\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### With Standalone Pipelines\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nimport { DocumentProcessingPipeline } from '@/features/ai/pipelines/document-processing-pipeline'\nimport { withKnowledgeForDocumentPipeline } from '@/features/ai/knowledge/pipeline-adapters'\n\n// Enhance the document pipeline with knowledge capabilities\nconst EnhancedDocumentPipeline = withKnowledgeForDocumentPipeline(DocumentProcessingPipeline)\n\nexport default function DocumentProcessingPage() {\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv className=\"container\"\u003e\n      \u003ch1\u003eDocument Processing\u003c/h1\u003e\n      \u003cEnhancedDocumentPipeline /\u003e\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  )\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Direct API Usage\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nimport { UnifiedKnowledgeAPI, KnowledgeSources } from '@/features/ai/knowledge'\n\n",

        "originalContents": "# Composite Knowledge Layer\n\nA unified knowledge management system that integrates multiple data sources and provides a consistent interface for AI pipelines.\n\n## Overview\n\nThe Composite Knowledge Layer provides a unified API for accessing and managing knowledge from various sources:\n\n- **Local Files**: Documents stored in the knowledge base directory\n- **OpenAI Vector Storage**: Embeddings and semantic search\n- **R2R**: External RAG implementation (Read, Retrieve, Route)\n- **Database (Xata)**: Structured data storage\n\n## Key Features\n\n- **Unified API**: Single interface for all knowledge operations\n- **Cross-Source Search**: Find information across all sources with deduplication\n- **AI Context Awareness**: Integration with Assistant UI for AI capabilities\n- **React Components**: Ready-to-use UI components for knowledge discovery\n- **Pipeline Integration**: Seamless integration with both unified and standalone pipelines\n\n## Usage\n\n### With Unified Pipeline\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nimport { IntegratedAIPipeline } from '@/features/ai/knowledge/integration'\n\nexport default function AIProcessingPage() {\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv className=\"container\"\u003e\n      \u003ch1\u003eAI Processing Hub\u003c/h1\u003e\n      \u003cIntegratedAIPipeline /\u003e\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  )\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### With Standalone Pipelines\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nimport { DocumentProcessingPipeline } from '@/features/ai/pipelines/document-processing-pipeline'\nimport { withKnowledgeForDocumentPipeline } from '@/features/ai/knowledge/pipeline-adapters'\n\n// Enhance the document pipeline with knowledge capabilities\nconst EnhancedDocumentPipeline = withKnowledgeForDocumentPipeline(DocumentProcessingPipeline)\n\nexport default function DocumentProcessingPage() {\n  return (\n    \u003cdiv className=\"container\"\u003e\n      \u003ch1\u003eDocument Processing\u003c/h1\u003e\n      \u003cEnhancedDocumentPipeline /\u003e\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  )\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### Direct API Usage\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nimport { UnifiedKnowledgeAPI, KnowledgeSources } from '@/features/ai/knowledge'\n\n",

        "contents": "# AIPipeline Implementation Documentation\n\n## Key Modules\n\n- **UnifiedPipelineContext**: Centralized context provider for all pipeline state and actions.\n- **Composite Knowledge Layer**: Combines data from all pipelines to provide unified insights.\n- **Document Processing Integration**: Processes and analyzes text documents.\n- **Web Processing Integration**: Analyzes web content by URL or search.\n- **Agent Execution Integration**: Executes AI agents with custom parameters.\n- **Export Functionality**: Exports composite data in JSON, Markdown, or CSV formats.\n\n## Process \u0026 Component Architecture\n\n### Data Flow\n\n1. **UnifiedPipelineProvider** manages all state and business logic.\n2. **Individual Pipeline Components** use the unified context to store and retrieve data.\n3. **Composite Knowledge View** aggregates and analyzes data from all pipelines.\n4. **AI Integration** generates cross-pipeline insights from aggregated data.\n5. **Assistant UI Integration** provides context awareness to AI assistants.\n\n### Component Structure\n\n- &#96;AIPipeline.tsx&#96; (main export)\n  - &#96;UnifiedPipelineProvider&#96;\n    - &#96;UnifiedPipelineInterfaceContent&#96;\n      - &#96;Tabs&#96; (unified, document, web, agent)\n        - &#96;CompositeKnowledgeView&#96; (unified tab)\n        - &#96;DocumentProcessingPipeline&#96; (document tab)\n        - &#96;WebProcessingPipeline&#96; (web tab)\n        - &#96;AgentExecutionPipeline&#96; (agent tab)\n\n### Implementation Details\n\n#### Data Types\n\n- **DocumentData**: Represents processed document information\n- **WebData**: Represents processed web resource information\n- **AgentData**: Represents agent execution results\n- **CompositeKnowledgeData**: Combines all data types in a unified structure\n\n#### Core Functions\n\n- **addDocumentData**: Adds document analysis to the composite layer\n- **addWebData**: Adds web analysis to the composite layer\n- **addAgentData**: Adds agent execution results to the composite layer\n- **generateCompositeInsights**: Creates unified insights across all data sources\n",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Generates contextual search rules based on current graph\n */\nexport function generateContextualSearchRules( context: GraphContext ): string {\n  try {\n    if ( !context ) {\n      return 'Find interesting records with clear relationships'\n    }\n\n    const rules: string[] = []\n\n    // Add temporal constraints with historical progression awareness\n    if ( context.timelineBounds.earliest \u0026\u0026 context.timelineBounds.latest ) {\n      const earliestYear = context.timelineBounds.earliest.getFullYear()\n      const latestYear = context.timelineBounds.latest.getFullYear()\n\n      if ( earliestYear === latestYear ) {\n        rules.push( &#96;Focus on events from ${earliestYear}&#96; )\n      } else {\n        rules.push( &#96;Focus on events between ${earliestYear} and ${latestYear}&#96; )\n      }\n\n      // Add historical progression suggestions\n      if ( context.historicalProgression ) {\n        rules.push( &#96;Consider chronological progression toward ${context.historicalProgression.nextChronologicalStep.suggestedYear}&#96; )\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Add entity relationship constraints\n    if ( context.keyPersonnel.length \u003e 0 ) {\n      const personnel = context.keyPersonnel.slice( 0, 3 ) // Limit to top 3 to avoid overly long rules\n      rules.push( &#96;Prioritize records involving: ${personnel.join( ', ' )}&#96; )\n    }\n\n    if ( context.organizations.length \u003e 0 ) {\n      const orgs = context.organizations.slice( 0, 3 ) // Limit to top 3\n      rules.push( &#96;Include connections to organizations: ${orgs.join( ', ' )}&#96; )\n    }\n\n    if ( context.relatedTopics.length \u003e 0 ) {\n      const topics = context.relatedTopics.slice( 0, 5 ) // Limit to top 5\n      rules.push( &#96;Focus on topics: ${topics.join( ', ' )}&#96; )\n    }\n\n    // Add location constraints\n    if ( context.locationContext ) {\n      rules.push( &#96;Consider geographic proximity to existing records within ${Math.round( context.locationContext.radius )}km&#96; )\n    }\n\n    // Enhanced guided tour context for specific exploration paths\n    const seedData = context.seedRecord?.data",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Analyzes the current graph to determine contextual relationships\n * for intelligent record filtering\n */\nexport function getGraphContext( nodes: Node[] ): GraphContext | null {\n  try {\n    // Validate input\n    if ( !Array.isArray( nodes ) ) {\n      console.warn( 'getGraphContext: nodes parameter is not an array' )\n      return null\n    }\n\n    // Filter out user input nodes to focus on actual data nodes\n    const dataNodes = nodes.filter( node =\u003e\n      node \u0026\u0026\n      node.type \u0026\u0026\n      node.type !== 'userInputNode' \u0026\u0026\n      node.data\n    )\n\n    // First record scenario - return null for open exploration\n    if ( dataNodes.length === 0 ) {\n      return null\n    }\n\n    // Extract context from existing nodes\n    const context: GraphContext = {\n      seedRecord: dataNodes[0], // First record establishes primary context\n      connectedEntityTypes: new Set\u003cstring\u003e(),\n      timelineBounds: {},\n      relatedTopics: [],\n      keyPersonnel: [],\n      organizations: []\n    }\n\n    // Track coordinates for location context\n    const coordinates: Array\u003c{ lat: number, lon: number }\u003e = []",

        "originalContents": "\n\n/**\n * Analyzes the current graph to determine contextual relationships\n * for intelligent record filtering\n */\nexport function getGraphContext( nodes: Node[] ): GraphContext | null {\n  try {\n    // Validate input\n    if ( !Array.isArray( nodes ) ) {\n      console.warn( 'getGraphContext: nodes parameter is not an array' )\n      return null\n    }\n\n    // Filter out user input nodes to focus on actual data nodes\n    const dataNodes = nodes.filter( node =\u003e\n      node \u0026\u0026\n      node.type \u0026\u0026\n      node.type !== 'userInputNode' \u0026\u0026\n      node.data\n    )\n\n    // First record scenario - return null for open exploration\n    if ( dataNodes.length === 0 ) {\n      return null\n    }\n\n    // Extract context from existing nodes\n    const context: GraphContext = {\n      seedRecord: dataNodes[0], // First record establishes primary context\n      connectedEntityTypes: new Set\u003cstring\u003e(),\n      timelineBounds: {},\n      relatedTopics: [],\n      keyPersonnel: [],\n      organizations: []\n    }\n\n    // Track coordinates for location context\n    const coordinates: Array\u003c{ lat: number, lon: number }\u003e = []",

        "contents": "# Mindmap with Assistant UI Integration\n\nThis directory contains the mindmap visualization components and integration with Assistant UI.\n\n## AI-Enhanced Graph Features\n\nThe AIEnabledGraph component wraps the standard Graph component with Assistant UI context awareness, enabling:\n\n1. Contextual AI assistance based on the current graph state\n2. Intelligent suggestions based on visible nodes and connections\n3. Direct AI interaction with the graph through function calling\n\n## Usage Example\n\nTo use the AI-enabled graph in a page:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n'use client'\n\nimport { MindMapProvider } from '@/contexts/mindmap/mindmap-context'\nimport { AIEnabledGraph } from '@/features/mindmap/smart-graph'\nimport { AssistantProvider } from '@assistant-ui/react'\n\nexport default function MindmapPage() {\n  return (\n    \u003cAssistantProvider\u003e\n      \u003cMindMapProvider\u003e\n        \u003cAIEnabledGraph /\u003e\n      \u003c/MindMapProvider\u003e\n    \u003c/AssistantProvider\u003e\n  )\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## How It Works\n\nThe implementation uses two key Assistant UI patterns:\n\n### 1. Model Context Provider\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n// Dynamically exposes the current graph state to the AI\nassistantRuntime.registerModelContextProvider({\n  getModelContext: () =\u003e ({\n    system: &#96;\n      # Mindmap Graph Context\n      - Total nodes: ${nodes.length}\n      - Active node: ${activeNode ? activeNode.id : 'None'}\n      ...\n    &#96;,\n  }),\n})\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. Function Registration\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\n// Registers functions that the AI can call to interact with the graph\nassistantRuntime.registerFunctions({\n  addNote: handleAddNote,\n  findConnections: handleFindConnections,\n  loadRelatedEntities: handleLoadRelatedEntities,\n  updateNodeLabel: handleUpdateNodeLabel,\n  deleteNode: handleDeleteNode,\n  reorganizeLayout: handleReorganizeLayout\n})\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Available AI Functions\n\nThe SmartGraph component exposes these functions to the assistant:\n\n| Function | Description | Parameters |\n|----------|-------------|------------|\n| &#96;addNote&#96; | Creates a new user input node | &#96;input: string, position?: {x, y}&#96; |\n",

        "contents": "# AIPipeline Implementation Pseudocode\n\n## 1. Context Provider (UnifiedPipelineContext)\n\n- Define types for unified state: DocumentProcessingState, WebProcessingState, AgentExecutionState\n- Create UnifiedPipelineContext with:\n  - activeTab: 'document' | 'web' | 'agent' | 'unified'\n  - setActiveTab(tab)\n  - isProcessing\n  - documentState, uploadDocument(file), analyzeDocument(documentId)\n  - webState, processWebUrl(url), summarizeWebContent(content)\n  - agentState, executeAgent(prompt, context?)\n  - combineResults(), exportResults(format)\n  - addToAIContext(data)\n- Implement UnifiedPipelineProvider:\n  - useState for all state\n  - useAssistantRuntime for AI context\n  - Implement all functions, calling legacy pipeline logic\n  - Register model context with assistantRuntime\n  - Provide context value\n- Export useUnifiedPipeline hook\n\n## 2. Adapter Utilities\n\n- mapDocumentStateToOriginal(unifiedState)\n- mapWebStateToOriginal(unifiedState)\n- mapAgentStateToOriginal(unifiedState)\n- mapDocumentStateToUnified(originalState)\n- mapWebStateToUnified(originalState)\n- mapAgentStateToUnified(originalState)\n\n## 3. Business Logic Integration\n\n- Import and re-export helpers from legacy pipelines:\n  - analyzeDocument, vectorizeDocument\n  - scrapeAndSummarize\n  - executeAgentWorkflow\n- Implement combinePipelineResults(documentResults, webResults, agentResults)\n- Implement createCrossContextualSummary(documentResults, webResults, agentResults)\n\n## 4. Adapter Components\n\n- DocumentProcessingAdapter:\n  - useUnifiedPipeline\n  - Map context to props for legacy DocumentProcessingPipeline\n  - Render UI using unified state\n- WebProcessingAdapter:\n  - useUnifiedPipeline\n  - Map context to props for legacy WebProcessingPipeline\n  - Render UI using unified state\n- AgentExecutionAdapter:\n  - useUnifiedPipeline\n  - Map context to props for legacy AgentExecutionPipeline\n  - Render UI using unified state\n\n## 5. Unified View\n\n- useUnifiedPipeline\n- Render quick input sections for each pipeline\n",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Generate tour-aware search rules\n */\nexport function generateTourAwareSearchRules( context: GraphContext ): string {\n  const baseRules = generateContextualSearchRules( context )\n  \n  if ( !context.tourContext ) {\n    return baseRules\n  }\n\n  const tourRules: string[] = []\n\n  // Add tour-specific context\n  if ( context.tourContext.tourMode === 'guided' ) {\n    tourRules.push( &#96;Following guided tour: ${context.tourContext.tourId}&#96; )\n    tourRules.push( &#96;Current waypoint context: ${context.tourContext.narrativeContext}&#96; )\n    \n    // Add chronological progression rules\n    if ( context.tourContext.historicalProgression.chronologicalDirection === 'forward' ) {\n      tourRules.push( &#96;Focus on events that chronologically follow the current period, leading toward ${context.tourContext.historicalProgression.nextSuggestedPeriod}&#96; )\n    } else if ( context.tourContext.historicalProgression.chronologicalDirection === 'backward' ) {\n      tourRules.push( &#96;Explore events that preceded the current period, showing historical context and antecedents&#96; )\n    }\n  } else {\n    // Free-form exploration with historical awareness\n    tourRules.push( 'Free-form exploration with intelligent historical context preservation' )\n    \n    if ( context.historicalProgression ) {\n      tourRules.push( &#96;Suggest chronological progression: ${context.historicalProgression.nextChronologicalStep.rationale}&#96; )\n    }\n  }\n\n  return [baseRules, tourRules.join( '. ' )].filter( Boolean ).join( '. ') + '.'\n}",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Determines if a new record is contextually related to the existing graph\n */\nexport function isRecordRelated( record: any, context: GraphContext ): boolean {\n  try {\n    if ( !record || !context ) {\n      return false\n    }\n\n    let relationshipScore = 0\n    const requiredScore = 1 // Minimum score to be considered related\n\n    // Check temporal relevance for events (weighted: 2 points)\n    if ( record.date \u0026\u0026 context.timelineBounds.earliest \u0026\u0026 context.timelineBounds.latest ) {\n      const recordDate = new Date( record.date )\n      if ( !isNaN( recordDate.getTime() ) ) {\n        const earliestDate = new Date( context.timelineBounds.earliest )\n        const latestDate = new Date( context.timelineBounds.latest )\n\n        // Allow records within a reasonable time window (e.g., +/- 10 years)\n        const timeWindow = 10 * 365 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000 // 10 years in milliseconds\n\n        if ( recordDate \u003e= new Date( earliestDate.getTime() - timeWindow ) \u0026\u0026\n          recordDate \u003c= new Date( latestDate.getTime() + timeWindow ) ) {\n          relationshipScore += 2\n        }\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Check for direct entity relationships (weighted: 3 points each)\n    const recordPersonnel = extractPersonnelFromRecord( record )\n    if ( recordPersonnel.some( person =\u003e context.keyPersonnel.includes( person ) ) ) {\n      relationshipScore += 3\n    }\n\n    const recordOrganizations = extractOrganizationsFromRecord( record )\n    if ( recordOrganizations.some( org =\u003e context.organizations.includes( org ) ) ) {\n      relationshipScore += 3\n    }\n\n    // Check for topic overlap (weighted: 2 points)\n    const recordTopics = extractTopicsFromRecord( record )\n    if ( recordTopics.some( topic =\u003e context.relatedTopics.includes( topic ) ) ) {\n      relationshipScore += 2\n    }",

        "originalContents": "import { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server'\nimport { askXataWithAi } from '@db/src/xata-typescript-sdk/api'\nimport { \n  getGraphContext, \n  generateTourAwareSearchRules, \n  determineHistoricalProgression,\n  type GraphContext \n} from '@/features/mindmap/utils/contextual-intelligence'\n\nexport interface HistoricalQueryRequest {\n  type: 'chronological-progression' | 'tour-waypoint' | 'contextual-expansion'\n  priority: 'high' | 'medium' | 'low'\n  graphContext: GraphContext\n  parameters: {\n    table: string\n    amount?: number\n    historicalFilter?: {\n      mode: 'chronological' | 'contextual' | 'free-form'\n      dateRange?: { startYear?: number; endYear?: number }\n      significance?: 'historically_important' | 'all' | 'disclosure_related'\n      progression?: 'forward' | 'backward' | 'context-based'\n    }\n    tourContext?: {\n      tourId: string\n      waypointId: string\n      tourMode: 'guided' | 'free-form'\n      narrativeContext: string\n    }\n  }\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "async function searchAcrossSources(query: string) {\n  const api = new UnifiedKnowledgeAPI()\n  \n  // Search across all sources\n  const results = await api.search(query)\n  \n  // Or specify particular sources\n  const documentResults = await api.search(query, { \n    sources: [KnowledgeSources.LOCAL, KnowledgeSources.DATABASE]\n  })\n  \n  return results\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### With React Context\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nimport { useKnowledge, KnowledgeProvider } from '@/features/ai/knowledge'\n\nfunction KnowledgeSearchComponent() {\n  const { search, searchResults, isLoading } = useKnowledge()\n  \n  const handleSearch = async (query: string) =\u003e {\n    await search(query)\n  }\n  \n  return (\n    \u003cdiv\u003e\n      \u003cinput \n        type=\"text\" \n        placeholder=\"Search knowledge...\" \n        onChange={(e) =\u003e handleSearch(e.target.value)}\n      /\u003e\n      \n      {isLoading ? (\n        \u003cdiv\u003eLoading...\u003c/div\u003e\n      ) : (\n        \u003cul\u003e\n          {searchResults.map(item =\u003e (\n            \u003cli key={item.id}\u003e{item.title}\u003c/li\u003e\n          ))}\n        \u003c/ul\u003e\n      )}\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  )\n}\n\n// Wrap with provider at a higher level\nexport default function KnowledgePage() {\n  return (\n    \u003cKnowledgeProvider\u003e\n      \u003cKnowledgeSearchComponent /\u003e\n    \u003c/KnowledgeProvider\u003e\n  )\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Architecture\n\nThe knowledge layer is built with a layered architecture:\n\n1. **Data Source Adapters**: Interface with individual knowledge sources\n   - &#96;LocalFilesAdapter&#96;, &#96;OpenAIVectorAdapter&#96;, &#96;R2RAdapter&#96;, &#96;XataAdapter&#96;\n\n2. **Unified Knowledge API**: Common interface for all knowledge operations\n   - &#96;UnifiedKnowledgeAPI&#96;\n\n3. **Knowledge Context Provider**: React context for UI components\n   - &#96;KnowledgeProvider&#96;, &#96;useKnowledge&#96;\n\n4. **UI Components**: Ready-to-use React components\n   - &#96;KnowledgePicker&#96;, &#96;KnowledgeViewer&#96;, &#96;KnowledgeEnabledPipeline&#96;\n\n5. **Integration Components**: Pre-built integrations for pipelines\n   - &#96;IntegratedAIPipeline&#96;, &#96;withKnowledgeForDocumentPipeline&#96;, etc.\n\n## Implementation Notes\n\n",
        "detailedLines": [
          {

            "text": "## Architecture"

          },

            "text": "The knowledge layer is built with a layered architecture:"

          },

            "text": "1. **Data Source Adapters**: Interface with individual knowledge sources"

          },

          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 130
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 131,

            "text": "   - &#96;KnowledgeProvider&#96;, &#96;useKnowledge&#96;"
          },
          {
            "lineNumber": 133
          },

            "text": "4. **UI Components**: Ready-to-use React components"

          },

        "originalContents": "async function searchAcrossSources(query: string) {\n  const api = new UnifiedKnowledgeAPI()\n  \n  // Search across all sources\n  const results = await api.search(query)\n  \n  // Or specify particular sources\n  const documentResults = await api.search(query, { \n    sources: [KnowledgeSources.LOCAL, KnowledgeSources.DATABASE]\n  })\n  \n  return results\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### With React Context\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;tsx\nimport { useKnowledge, KnowledgeProvider } from '@/features/ai/knowledge'\n\nfunction KnowledgeSearchComponent() {\n  const { search, searchResults, isLoading } = useKnowledge()\n  \n  const handleSearch = async (query: string) =\u003e {\n    await search(query)\n  }\n  \n  return (\n    \u003cdiv\u003e\n      \u003cinput \n        type=\"text\" \n        placeholder=\"Search knowledge...\" \n        onChange={(e) =\u003e handleSearch(e.target.value)}\n      /\u003e\n      \n      {isLoading ? (\n        \u003cdiv\u003eLoading...\u003c/div\u003e\n      ) : (\n        \u003cul\u003e\n          {searchResults.map(item =\u003e (\n            \u003cli key={item.id}\u003e{item.title}\u003c/li\u003e\n          ))}\n        \u003c/ul\u003e\n      )}\n    \u003c/div\u003e\n  )\n}\n\n// Wrap with provider at a higher level\nexport default function KnowledgePage() {\n  return (\n    \u003cKnowledgeProvider\u003e\n      \u003cKnowledgeSearchComponent /\u003e\n    \u003c/KnowledgeProvider\u003e\n  )\n}\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n## Architecture\n\nThe knowledge layer is built with a layered architecture:\n\n1. **Data Source Adapters**: Interface with individual knowledge sources\n   - &#96;LocalFilesAdapter&#96;, &#96;OpenAIVectorAdapter&#96;, &#96;R2RAdapter&#96;, &#96;XataAdapter&#96;\n\n2. **Unified Knowledge API**: Common interface for all knowledge operations\n   - &#96;UnifiedKnowledgeAPI&#96;\n\n3. **Knowledge Context Provider**: React context for UI components\n   - &#96;KnowledgeProvider&#96;, &#96;useKnowledge&#96;\n\n4. **UI Components**: Ready-to-use React components\n   - &#96;KnowledgePicker&#96;, &#96;KnowledgeViewer&#96;, &#96;KnowledgeEnabledPipeline&#96;\n\n5. **Integration Components**: Pre-built integrations for pipelines\n   - &#96;IntegratedAIPipeline&#96;, &#96;withKnowledgeForDocumentPipeline&#96;, etc.\n\n## Implementation Notes\n\n",

        "contents": "## AUDIT PHASE PROGRESS (Apr 27, 2025)\n\n### Pipelines Inventory\n\n- agent-execution-pipeline\n- document-processing-pipeline\n- web-processing-pipeline\n\n### Patterns Observed\n\n- **UI:** &#96;.tsx&#96; components manage views, input, output, state.\n- **Business Logic:**\n  - In &#96;helpers/&#96; for document pipeline (analyze, vectorize, extract).\n  - In some cases, async calls/side effects/state in UI components.\n  - Agent \u0026 web pipelines: as actions, less extracted logic.\n- **Coupling:**\n  - Direct use of business logic in UI (async, state, calls).\n  - Document pipeline better decoupled, but not universal.\n  - No single shared hook/service pattern/approach.\n  - No use of context providers for cross-component shared state.\n\n### Immediate Follow-Ups\n\n- [ ] List files per pattern for more granular checklist\n- [ ] Identify candidate business logic to extract into services/hooks\n- [ ] Map all direct API/store/service invocations in UI\n\n---\n\n### Content to be placed in INTELLIGENT_UI_BUSINESS_LOGIC_STATUS.md\n\n# INTELLIGENT UI \u0026 BUSINESS LOGIC SYNC STATUS\n\n## Path: /Users/liamellis/Desktop/ultraterrestrial-resurrection/apps/app/src/features/ai/pipelines\n\n### Last Updated: April 27, 2025\n\n---\n\n## Implementation Plan: Intelligent Combination of UI \u0026 Business Logic in Pipelines\n\n### 1. Audit and Analyze Current Patterns\n\n- Inventory all current pipelines/components\n- Identify UI-business logic connection points\n- Document coupling (tight/loose, direct/indirect)\n- Categorize repeated or reusable patterns\n\n### 2. Define Separation of Concerns\n\n- Move all pure business logic to pipeline/service modules\n- Ensure business logic is testable and UI-agnostic\n- UI components should only consume state/data via hooks, context, or props\n\n### 3. Create a Shared Interface/Contract\n\n- Use context/store/hooks for stateful/shared pipeline logic\n- Define TS types/interfaces for communication between UI and logic\n\n### 4. Refactor: Decouple \u0026 Recompose\n\n- Refactor core logic into pure service modules or hooks\n",

        "originalContents": "\n\nconst DEFAULT_OPTIONS: GroupingOptions = {\n  minGroupSize: 2,\n  maxGroupDistance: 200,\n  persistenceThreshold: 3000, // 3 seconds\n  boundaryPadding: 30,\n  autoCollapse: false,\n  maxGroupsVisible: 5\n}\n\nexport function useSpatialGrouping(options: Partial\u003cGroupingOptions\u003e = {}) {\n  const config = { ...DEFAULT_OPTIONS, ...options }\n  const { nodes } = useMindMapStore()\n  const { proximityGroups, analysisResults } = useProximityAnalysis()\n  \n  const [spatialGroups, setSpatialGroups] = useState\u003cMap\u003cstring, SpatialGroup\u003e\u003e(new Map())\n  const [selectedGroupId, setSelectedGroupId] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null)\n  const [draggedGroupId, setDraggedGroupId] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null)\n  \n  const persistenceTimers = useRef\u003cMap\u003cstring, NodeJS.Timeout\u003e\u003e(new Map())\n  const groupIdCounter = useRef(0)\n  \n  // Calculate boundary box for a set of nodes\n  const calculateBoundary = useCallback((groupNodes: Node[]) =\u003e {\n    if (groupNodes.length === 0) {\n      return { x: 0, y: 0, width: 0, height: 0 }\n    }\n    \n    const positions = groupNodes.map(node =\u003e ({\n      x: node.position.x,\n      y: node.position.y,\n      width: node.measured?.width || 200,\n      height: node.measured?.height || 100\n    }))\n    \n    const minX = Math.min(...positions.map(p =\u003e p.x))\n    const minY = Math.min(...positions.map(p =\u003e p.y))\n    const maxX = Math.max(...positions.map(p =\u003e p.x + p.width))\n    const maxY = Math.max(...positions.map(p =\u003e p.y + p.height))\n    \n    return {\n      x: minX - config.boundaryPadding,\n      y: minY - config.boundaryPadding,\n      width: maxX - minX + (config.boundaryPadding * 2),\n      height: maxY - minY + (config.boundaryPadding * 2)\n    }\n  }, [config.boundaryPadding])",

        "contents": "export function useTourWithSpatialIntelligence(spatialConfig: Partial\u003cTourSpatialConfig\u003e = {}) {\n\n  \n  ...\n\n  \n  // Auto-group nodes when waypoints change (if enabled)\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (!config.enableAutoGrouping || !tourHook.currentWaypoint) return\n    \n    const currentNodes = getNodes()\n    if (currentNodes.length \u003c 2) return\n    \n    // Check if we should create narrative groups based on tour context\n    if (config.enableNarrativeGrouping \u0026\u0026 tourHook.tourContext) {\n      const thematicGroups = identifyThematicGroups(currentNodes, tourHook.currentWaypoint)\n      \n      thematicGroups.forEach(async ({ nodeIds, theme }) =\u003e {\n        if (nodeIds.length \u003e= 2) {\n          await createTourNarrativeGroup(nodeIds, theme, tourHook.currentWaypoint!.id)\n        }\n      })\n    }\n  }, [tourHook.currentWaypoint, getNodes, config.enableAutoGrouping, config.enableNarrativeGrouping])\n  \n  return {\n    // Include all base tour functionality\n    ...tourHook,\n    \n    // Enhanced spatial intelligence functionality\n    navigateToWaypoint: navigateToWaypointWithSpatialContext,\n    \n    // Spatial tour state\n    tourSpatialState,\n    spatialGroups: spatialHook.spatialGroups,\n    \n    // Spatial tour actions\n    createTourNarrativeGroup,\n    suggestRecordsFromSpatialContext,\n    executeSuggestedGroupAction,\n    getSpatialProgressionSummary,\n    \n    // Spatial grouping controls\n    toggleGroupCollapse: spatialHook.toggleGroupCollapse,\n    dissolveGroup: spatialHook.dissolveGroup,\n    selectGroup: spatialHook.selectGroup,\n    \n    // Configuration\n    spatialConfig: config\n  }\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  // Batch analysis for multiple nodes\n  const analyzeBatch = useCallback(\n    debounce((nodeIds: string[]) =\u003e {\n      if (!enabled) return [];\n\n      const results = [];\n      for (const nodeId of nodeIds) {\n        const result = analyzeProximity(nodeId);\n        if (result) {\n          results.push(result);\n        }\n      }\n      return results;\n    }, 200), // Debounce batch operations\n    [analyzeProximity, enabled]\n  );\n\n  // Optimized group detection\n  const detectGroups = useMemo(() =\u003e {\n    if (!enabled) return [];\n\n    const groups: any[] = [];\n    const visited = new Set\u003cstring\u003e();\n\n    for (const node of nodes) {\n      if (visited.has(node.id)) continue;\n\n      const nearbyIds = spatialIndex.current.findNearby(node.id, threshold);\n      if (nearbyIds.length \u003e 0) {\n        const group = [node.id, ...nearbyIds];\n        group.forEach(id =\u003e visited.add(id));\n        groups.push({\n          id: &#96;group-${groups.length}&#96;,\n          nodeIds: group,\n          center: calculateGroupCenter(group.map(id =\u003e nodes.find(n =\u003e n.id === id)).filter(Boolean)),\n          strength: group.length / nodes.length\n        });\n      }\n    }\n\n    return groups;\n  }, [nodes, threshold, enabled]);\n\n  // Performance monitoring\n  const performanceMetrics = useRef({\n    analysisCount: 0,\n    avgAnalysisTime: 0,\n    cacheHitRate: 0,\n    totalCacheRequests: 0,\n    cacheHits: 0\n  });\n\n  const updatePerformanceMetrics = useCallback((analysisTime: number, cacheHit: boolean) =\u003e {\n    const metrics = performanceMetrics.current;\n    metrics.analysisCount++;\n    metrics.avgAnalysisTime = (metrics.avgAnalysisTime + analysisTime) / 2;\n    metrics.totalCacheRequests++;\n    \n    if (cacheHit) {\n      metrics.cacheHits++;\n    }\n    \n    metrics.cacheHitRate = metrics.cacheHits / metrics.totalCacheRequests;\n  }, []);",

        "contents": "\n\n// Optimized spatial intelligence hook\nexport function useOptimizedSpatialIntelligence(\n  nodes: any[],\n  threshold: number = 150,\n  enabled: boolean = true\n) {\n  const spatialIndex = useRef\u003cSpatialIndex\u003e(new SpatialIndex());\n  const analysisCache = useRef\u003cMap\u003cstring, any\u003e\u003e(new Map());\n  const lastAnalysisTime = useRef\u003cnumber\u003e(0);\n\n  // Build spatial index when nodes change\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    if (!enabled) return;\n\n    spatialIndex.current.clear();\n    analysisCache.current.clear();\n\n    for (const node of nodes) {\n      if (node.position) {\n        spatialIndex.current.insert(node.id, node.position);\n      }\n    }\n  }, [nodes, enabled]);\n\n  // Optimized proximity analysis with caching\n  const analyzeProximity = useCallback(\n    throttle((nodeId: string) =\u003e {\n      if (!enabled) return null;\n\n      const now = Date.now();\n      const cacheKey = &#96;${nodeId}-${threshold}&#96;;\n      \n      // Check cache first\n      const cached = analysisCache.current.get(cacheKey);\n      if (cached \u0026\u0026 now -         "contents": "\n\nfunction generateTourGroupActions(\n  groups: SpatialGroup[], \n  context: GraphContext, \n  waypoint: any\n): TourSpatialState['suggestedGroupActions'] {\n  const actions: TourSpatialState['suggestedGroupActions'] = []\n  \n  groups.forEach(group =\u003e {\n    // Suggest expansion for high-confidence groups\n    if (group.metadata.confidence \u003e 0.7 \u0026\u0026 group.nodes.length \u003c 5) {\n      actions.push({\n        groupId: group.id,\n        action: 'expand',\n        reason: &#96;High-confidence ${group.metadata.dominantType} group could reveal more related records&#96;,\n        priority: 'high'\n      })\n    }\n    \n    // Suggest research sessions for substantial groups\n    if (group.nodes.length \u003e= 3) {\n      actions.push({\n        groupId: group.id,\n        action: 'research',\n        reason: &#96;Substantial ${group.metadata.dominantType} group warrants deeper investigation&#96;,\n        priority: 'medium'\n      })\n    }\n    \n    // Suggest contextualization for tour-relevant groups\n    if (context.tourContext \u0026\u0026 group.metadata.dominantType === 'events') {\n      actions.push({\n        groupId: group.id,\n        action: 'contextualize',\n        reason: &#96;Event cluster relevant to tour narrative: ${context.tourContext.narrativeContext}&#96;,\n        priority: 'medium'\n      })\n    }\n  })\n  \n  // Suggest connections between compatible groups\n  for (let i = 0; i \u003c groups.length; i++) {\n    for (let j = i + 1; j \u003c groups.length; j++) {\n      const group1 = groups[i]\n      const group2 = groups[j]\n      \n      if (areGroupsCompatible(group1, group2)) {\n        actions.push({\n          groupId: group1.id,\n          action: 'connect',\n          reason: &#96;${group1.metadata.dominantType} and ${group2.metadata.dominantType} groups show potential connections&#96;,\n          priority: 'low'\n        })\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  \n  return actions.slice(0, 6) // Limit to 6 suggestions\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\nfunction generateTourGroupActions(\n  groups: SpatialGroup[], \n  context: GraphContext, \n  waypoint: any\n): TourSpatialState['suggestedGroupActions'] {\n  const actions: TourSpatialState['suggestedGroupActions'] = []\n  \n  groups.forEach(group =\u003e {\n    // Suggest expansion for high-confidence groups\n    if (group.metadata.confidence \u003e 0.7 \u0026\u0026 group.nodes.length \u003c 5) {\n      actions.push({\n        groupId: group.id,\n        action: 'expand',\n        reason: &#96;High-confidence ${group.metadata.dominantType} group could reveal more related records&#96;,\n        priority: 'high'\n      })\n    }\n    \n    // Suggest research sessions for substantial groups\n    if (group.nodes.length \u003e= 3) {\n      actions.push({\n        groupId: group.id,\n        action: 'research',\n        reason: &#96;Substantial ${group.metadata.dominantType} group warrants deeper investigation&#96;,\n        priority: 'medium'\n      })\n    }\n    \n    // Suggest contextualization for tour-relevant groups\n    if (context.tourContext \u0026\u0026 group.metadata.dominantType === 'events') {\n      actions.push({\n        groupId: group.id,\n        action: 'contextualize',\n        reason: &#96;Event cluster relevant to tour narrative: ${context.tourContext.narrativeContext}&#96;,\n        priority: 'medium'\n      })\n    }\n  })\n  \n  // Suggest connections between compatible groups\n  for (let i = 0; i \u003c groups.length; i++) {\n    for (let j = i + 1; j \u003c groups.length; j++) {\n      const group1 = groups[i]\n      const group2 = groups[j]\n      \n      if (areGroupsCompatible(group1, group2)) {\n        actions.push({\n          groupId: group1.id,\n          action: 'connect',\n          reason: &#96;${group1.metadata.dominantType} and ${group2.metadata.dominantType} groups show potential connections&#96;,\n          priority: 'low'\n        })\n      }\n    }\n  }\n  \n  return actions.slice(0, 6) // Limit to 6 suggestions\n}",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "import type { Node } from '@xyflow/react'\nimport { getNodeType, ENHANCED_FEATURES } from '@/features/mindmap/config/enhanced-node-mapping'\nimport { getGraphContext } from './contextual-intelligence'\n\n/**\n * Enhances node data with additional properties for the new UI components\n */\nexport function enhanceNodeData( node: Node, allNodes: Node[] ): Node {\n  const graphContext = getGraphContext( allNodes )\n  const isContextualNode = graphContext \u0026\u0026 graphContext.connectedEntityTypes.has( node.data?.type )\n\n  const enhancedData = {\n    ...node.data,\n\n    // Contextual intelligence indicators\n    isContextual: isContextualNode || node.data?.isContextual,\n    contextInfo: node.data?.contextInfo || ( isContextualNode\n      ? &#96;Part of ${graphContext?.connectedEntityTypes.size || 0}-entity network&#96;\n      : undefined ),\n\n    // Enhanced visual properties\n    credibilityScore: node.data?.credibility || node.data?.authority || node.data?.rank,\n    connectionCount: 0, // Will be calculated by the component\n\n    // Research integration\n    isBookmarked: node.data?.isBookmarked || false,\n    hasNotes: node.data?.hasNotes || false,\n\n    // UI state\n    isExpanded: node.data?.isExpanded || false,\n    lastInteraction: node.data?.lastInteraction || Date.now(),\n  }\n\n  return {\n    ...node,\n    type: getNodeType( node.type || 'entityNode' ),\n    data: enhancedData,\n  }\n}",

        "originalContents": "import type { Node } from '@xyflow/react'\nimport { getNodeType, ENHANCED_FEATURES } from '@/features/mindmap/config/enhanced-node-mapping'\nimport { getGraphContext } from './contextual-intelligence'\n\n/**\n * Enhances node data with additional properties for the new UI components\n */\nexport function enhanceNodeData( node: Node, allNodes: Node[] ): Node {\n  const graphContext = getGraphContext( allNodes )\n  const isContextualNode = graphContext \u0026\u0026 graphContext.connectedEntityTypes.has( node.data?.type )\n\n  const enhancedData = {\n    ...node.data,\n\n    // Contextual intelligence indicators\n    isContextual: isContextualNode || node.data?.isContextual,\n    contextInfo: node.data?.contextInfo || ( isContextualNode\n      ? &#96;Part of ${graphContext?.connectedEntityTypes.size || 0}-entity network&#96;\n      : undefined ),\n\n    // Enhanced visual properties\n    credibilityScore: node.data?.credibility || node.data?.authority || node.data?.rank,\n    connectionCount: 0, // Will be calculated by the component\n\n    // Research integration\n    isBookmarked: node.data?.isBookmarked || false,\n    hasNotes: node.data?.hasNotes || false,\n\n    // UI state\n    isExpanded: node.data?.isExpanded || false,\n    lastInteraction: node.data?.lastInteraction || Date.now(),\n  }\n\n  return {\n    ...node,\n    type: getNodeType( node.type || 'entityNode' ),\n    data: enhancedData,\n  }\n}",

        "contents": "\n\n/**\n * Creates an enhanced entity node with rich UFO data display\n */\nexport function createEnhancedEntityNode(\n  id: string,\n  entityData: any,\n  position: { x: number; y: number },\n  allNodes: Node[]\n): Node {\n  const graphContext = getGraphContext( allNodes )\n  const isContextual = graphContext \u0026\u0026 graphContext.connectedEntityTypes.has( entityData.type )\n\n  return {\n    id,\n    type: getNodeType( 'entityNode' ),\n    position,\n    data: {\n      ...entityData,\n      isContextual,\n      contextInfo: isContextual\n        ? &#96;Related to ${graphContext?.keyPersonnel.length || 0} key figures&#96;\n        : undefined,\n\n      // Enhanced data formatting\n      formattedDate: entityData.date ? new Date( entityData.date ).toLocaleDateString() : undefined,\n\n      // Display properties\n      credibilityScore: entityData.credibility || entityData.authority || entityData.rank,\n      hasPhotos: !!( entityData.photos \u0026\u0026 entityData.photos.length \u003e 0 ),\n      hasLocation: !!( entityData.latitude \u0026\u0026 entityData.longitude ),\n\n      // UI state\n      isExpanded: false,\n      isBookmarked: false,\n      lastViewed: Date.now(),\n    },\n  }\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\n/**\n * Creates an enhanced entity node with rich UFO data display\n */\nexport function createEnhancedEntityNode(\n  id: string,\n  entityData: any,\n  position: { x: number; y: number },\n  allNodes: Node[]\n): Node {\n  const graphContext = getGraphContext( allNodes )\n  const isContextual = graphContext \u0026\u0026 graphContext.connectedEntityTypes.has( entityData.type )\n\n  return {\n    id,\n    type: getNodeType( 'entityNode' ),\n    position,\n    data: {\n      ...entityData,\n      isContextual,\n      contextInfo: isContextual\n        ? &#96;Related to ${graphContext?.keyPersonnel.length || 0} key figures&#96;\n        : undefined,\n\n      // Enhanced data formatting\n      formattedDate: entityData.date ? new Date( entityData.date ).toLocaleDateString() : undefined,\n\n      // Display properties\n      credibilityScore: entityData.credibility || entityData.authority || entityData.rank,\n      hasPhotos: !!( entityData.photos \u0026\u0026 entityData.photos.length \u003e 0 ),\n      hasLocation: !!( entityData.latitude \u0026\u0026 entityData.longitude ),\n\n      // UI state\n      isExpanded: false,\n      isBookmarked: false,\n      lastViewed: Date.now(),\n    },\n  }\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n  \n  function extractYearFromNodeData(data: any): number | null {\n    if (!data) return null\n    \n    // Try multiple date fields\n    const dateFields = ['date', 'occurred_on', 'created_at', 'year']\n    for (const field of dateFields) {\n      const dateValue = data[field]\n      if (dateValue) {\n        const date = new Date(dateValue)\n        if (!isNaN(date.getTime())) {\n          return date.getFullYear()\n        }\n        // Try parsing as year directly\n        const year = parseInt(dateValue.toString(), 10)\n        if (year \u003e= 1900 \u0026\u0026 year \u003c= new Date().getFullYear()) {\n          return year\n        }\n      }\n    }\n    return null\n  }\n  \n  function getTourBadgeInfo(): { icon: React.ReactNode; text: string; color: string } | null {\n    if (!tourContext || !isTourRelated) return null\n    \n    // Determine badge based on tour mode and historical significance\n    if (tourContext.tourMode === 'guided') {\n      if (isHistoricallySignificant) {\n        return {\n          icon: \u003cClock className=\"w-3 h-3\" /\u003e,\n          text: 'Historical',\n          color: 'bg-amber-500/90'\n        }\n      } else {\n        return {\n          icon: \u003cMapPin className=\"w-3 h-3\" /\u003e,\n          text: 'Tour',\n          color: 'bg-blue-500/90'\n        }\n      }\n    } else {\n      return {\n        icon: \u003cUsers className=\"w-3 h-3\" /\u003e,\n        text: 'Explored',\n        color: 'bg-green-500/90'\n      }\n    }\n  }",

        "originalContents": "\n\nconst ASSISTANT_ID = 'asst_xxxx'\nlet THREAD_ID = ''\nlet RUN_ID = ''\n\nexport async function submitMessage(question: string): Promise\u003cClientMessage\u003e {\n  const status = createStreamableUI('thread.init')\n  const textStream = createStreamableValue('')\n  const textUIStream = createStreamableUI(\u003cMessage textStream={textStream.value} /\u003e)\n  const gui = createStreamableUI()\n\n  const runQueue = []\n\n  ;(async () =\u003e {\n    if (THREAD_ID) {\n      await openai.beta.threads.messages.create(THREAD_ID, {\n        role: 'user',\n        content: question,\n      })\n\n      const run = await openai.beta.threads.runs.create(THREAD_ID, {\n        assistant_id: ASSISTANT_ID,\n        stream: true,\n      })\n\n      runQueue.push({id: generateId(), run})\n    } else {\n      const run = await openai.beta.threads.createAndRun({\n        assistant_id: ASSISTANT_ID,\n        metadata,\n        tool_resources: {\n          file_search: {\n            vector_store_ids: ['vs_meWOEnUiUxtQWf0W6NBsNpCG'],\n          },\n        },\n        tool_choice: 'required',\n        tools: [{type: 'file_search'}, {type: 'function', function: {name: 'search_database'}}],\n        stream: true,\n        thread: {\n          messages: [{role: 'user', content: question}],\n        },\n      })\n\n      runQueue.push({id: generateId(), run})\n    }",

        "contents": "\n\nexport const askAIAction = async ( { question, rules, table }: AskParams ) =\u003e {\n\ttry {\n\t\t// Use Prometheus AI instead of direct Xata calls\n\t\tconsole.log( \"🤖 Using Prometheus AI for enhanced node data\" )\n\t\tconst enhancedData = await getEnhancedNodeData( question, table, rules )\n\n\t\tconsole.log( \"enhancedData: \", enhancedData )\n\n\t\t// The enhanced data now returns full records, not just IDs\n\t\t// Return the full response with reasoning for edge annotations\n\t\tconst response = {\n\t\t\tanswer: enhancedData.answer,\n\t\t\tsessionId: enhancedData.sessionId,\n\t\t\trecords: enhancedData.records, // Full records, not just IDs\n\t\t\treasoning: enhancedData.reasoning // Prometheus reasoning for edge annotations\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tconsole.log( \"response: \", response )\n\t\treturn response\n\t} catch ( error ) {\n\t\tconsole.error( \"Error in askAIAction:\", error )\n\t\t// Fallback to direct Xata if Prometheus fails\n\t\tconsole.log( \"⚠️ Falling back to direct Xata query\" )\n\t\tconst dbResponse = await askXataWithAi( { question, table, rules } )\n\t\treturn JSON.parse( JSON.stringify( dbResponse ) )\n\t}\n}",

        "contents": "\n\n// Enhanced function to get node data with Prometheus AI integration\nexport async function getEnhancedNodeData(\n  question: string,\n  table: string,\n  rules?: string\n): Promise\u003c{answer: string; records: any[]; sessionId: string; reasoning?: any[]}\u003e {\n  try {\n    console.log('🤖 Getting enhanced node data via Prometheus')\n\n    // First, use the existing search database function to get actual records\n    const searchResults = await searchDatabase({\n      table,\n      searchTerms: [question],\n      searchFields: ['name', 'description', 'summary', 'title'],\n      limit: 3, // Limit to 3 as per user requirements\n      sortBy: 'relevance',\n    })\n\n    console.log('🔍 Search results:', searchResults)\n\n    if (searchResults.length === 0) {\n      return {\n        answer: 'No relevant records found',\n        records: [],\n        sessionId: '',\n        reasoning: [],\n      }\n    }\n\n    // Enhanced prompt to get specific reasoning for each record selection\n    const recordSummaries = searchResults\n      .map(\n        (record, index) =\u003e\n          &#96;Record ${index + 1}: ${record.name || record.title || &#96;ID: ${record.id}&#96;} - ${record.description || record.summary || 'No description'}&#96;\n      )\n      .join('\\n')\n\n    const analysisPrompt = &#96;You are analyzing ${table} records related to the query: \"${question}\"\n\nFound Records:\n${recordSummaries}\n\n${rules || 'Provide contextual insights and connections.'}\n\nPlease provide:\n1. Overall analysis of why these ${table} records are relevant to \"${question}\"\n2. For each record, explain specifically WHY it was chosen and its connection to the original query\n3.         "contents": "import { openai } from '@ai-sdk/openai';\nimport { streamText, tool } from 'ai';\nimport { Langbase } from 'langbase';\nimport { z } from 'zod';\nimport { NextRequest, NextResponse } from 'next/server';\n\n// Constants\nconst DEFAULT_SEARCH_LIMIT = 10;\nconst CONTENT_PREVIEW_LENGTH = 6000;\nconst SUMMARY_CONTENT_LENGTH = 8000;\nconst TAGS_CONTENT_LENGTH = 4000;\nconst MAX_TOPICS = 12;\nconst MAX_TAGS = 12;\nconst MIN_TAGS = 8;\nconst MODEL_NAME = 'gpt-4-turbo'; // Fixed model name\n\n// Rate limiting and caching\nconst RATE_LIMIT_WINDOW = 60 * 1000; // 1 minute\nconst RATE_LIMIT_MAX_REQUESTS = 30; // Max requests per window\nconst CACHE_TTL = 5 * 60 * 1000; // 5 minutes cache\n\n// In-memory stores (for development - use Redis in production)\nconst rateLimitStore = new Map\u003cstring, { count: number; resetTime: number }\u003e();\nconst responseCache = new Map\u003cstring, { data: any; timestamp: number }\u003e();\nconst metricsStore = {\n  requests: 0,\n  successful: 0,\n  failed: 0,\n  avgResponseTime: 0,\n  lastReset: Date.now()\n};\n\n// Types\ninterface SearchResult {\n  query: string;\n  results: Array\u003c{\n    content: string;\n    relevance: string;\n    source: string;\n  }\u003e;\n  totalResults: number;\n  error?: string;\n}",

        "originalContents": "\n\n\t\t// Create user prompt with the combined data\n\t\tconst userPrompt = &#96;Analyze the following combined UFO sightings and events data and provide structured insights:\\n\\n${JSON.stringify(dataSummary, null, 2)}&#96;;\n\n\t\t// Create streamable value for incremental updates\n\t\tconst stream = createStreamableValue();\n\n\t\t// Make the OpenAI API call with streaming\n\t\tconst { partialObjectStream } = await streamObject({\n\t\t\tmodel: openai.responses(\"gpt-4-turbo-preview\"),\n\t\t\tsystem: systemPrompt,\n\t\t\tprompt: userPrompt,\n\t\t\tschema: analysisSchema,\n\t\t});\n\n\t\tconsole.log(\n\t\t\t\"🚀 ~ analyzeSightingsData ~ API call initiated for combined data analysis\",\n\t\t);\n\n\t\t// Process the streaming response\n\t\tfor await (const partialObject of partialObjectStream) {\n\t\t\tconsole.log(\n\t\t\t\t\"🚀 ~ analyzeSightingsData ~ partialObject update:\",\n\t\t\t\tObject.keys(partialObject).length,\n\t\t\t);\n\t\t\tstream.update(partialObject);\n\t\t}\n\n\t\tstream.done;\n\n\t\t// Return both the analysis and the streaming value\n\t\treturn {\n\t\t\tanalysis: stream.value as SightingsAnalysisResult,\n\t\t\tstreamingValue: stream,\n\t\t};\n\t} catch (error) {\n\t\tconsole.error(\"Error analyzing combined data:\", error);\n\t\tthrow new Error(\n\t\t\t&#96;Failed to analyze combined data: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}&#96;,\n\t\t);\n\t}\n};",
